title: Map Mod Manager (41 and 42)
description:
Map Mod Manager is a tool for managing and organizing your map mods. With a cell grid display, you can visually identify conflicts between maps, regardless of if you're subscribed to them or picked from the huge database of over 800 maps. Whether you're curating a fine collection of maps, checking your current subscriptions for conflicts or expanding your map collection, Map Mod Manager is the tool to help you do it.

[h3]Interactive Cell Display:[/h3]
View maps on a detailed grid, highlighting selected mods to identify conflicts between themselves or vanilla areas.
[h3]Toggle Mods:[/h3]
Quickly activate or deactivate mods and their dependencies you're already subscribed to, so you don't have to go back into mods to manage them.
[h3]Quick Select and Filter Maps:[/h3]
Quickly select map mods that don't conflict with your current selection or filter by cell/s.
[h3]Steam Links:[/h3]
Subscribing to a mod is as easy as clicking on that link and subscribing - if it works with your current collection, you can update it in seconds (with a refresh of the game, of course).
[h3]Dependency Check:[/h3]
Know what mods are required with your selected/enabled maps, ensuring you don't miss anything essential to prevent in-game issues like missing tiles or unexpected behavior. Hover over a dependency to check what maps are dependent on it.
[h3]Export Data (Build 41):[/h3]
The export function generates a list of selected maps, including their URL's, dependencies and multiplayer data, enabling you to quickly set up a server or share it with a mate.


[h2]How do I use it?[/h2]
[list]
    [*]Enable it in mods, save and go back to the main menu. A button called 'Map Mod Manager' will appear right under the Quit button.
    [*]Select maps to show them on the cell grid, conflicting maps appear red, if they conflict with a vanilla map they appear yellow.
    [*]Purple cells are map mods without conflicts, green and blue cells are vanilla maps.
    [*]Hover your mouse over any cell in the grid to show what map/s are occupying that cell.
    [*]If you're subscribed to a map, it will appear in the Subscribed Map Mods list, green maps are enabled.
    [*]Dependencies will populate for both active mods and selected mods, active mods are green, required dependencies that aren't enabled are white, dependencies you aren't subscribed to are red.
    [*]Hover over a dependency to see what map enabled it.
    [*]Use the steam link next to any map or dependency to navigate to the workshop page, if you subscribe to a new mod, you'll need to quit and re-open the game for it to show up in your Subscribed Map Mods list.
    [*]Buttons have tooltips, so you know exactly what they are doing.
    [*]Mod changes are saved by closing the UI.
[/list]

Note, if you have increased your font size, you will have issues displaying the UI. Reduce your font size to default while using this mod.

title: [B42] Week One NPC
description:
[h1]Week One B42 ONLY[/h1]

[b] IMPORTANT: Mod updated to work with the newest version of Bandits v2.[/b]

[b]Week One[/b] let's you begin the game 7 days before the zombie outbreak. You will start in a clean, zombie-free world along with other people (NPCs). It will be your choice whether you want to be a decent citizen, a serial killer or somebody else, just remember that your actions have consequences. 

Over time you will experience the progression of events leading to the unavoidable Knox Event. You are immune to the airborne transmission as well as some other survivors. But most of the people are not.  

There are many hidden features that you will have to discover yourself. Your will receive some clues during sleep. Please do not post spoilers in the comments. If you are lost and like spoilers, check [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/3403180543/592885886403779634/]guide[/url]

This mod isn’t meant to be a faithful simulation of reality — it’s not possible to achieve that. Instead, it’s supposed to be funny, so take it lightly when things don’t go as planned. Based on your feedback, I may refine it over time.

Don’t expect a peaceful experience either. You won’t get a leisurely seven-day grace period without zombies to prepare. Things escalate quickly, and the intensity ramps up fast. Be ready to adapt to new challenges, even if it means player deaths along the way.

[/list]

    [*][b]Base mod[/b] - Framework, doesn't add any customisation options

    [*][b]Details Pack HD Textures[/b] - 512x512 textures for the Details Pack.
Do not use this with the vanilla body textures or any retextures that are 256x256 or it will cause seams.[/list]
[/quote]

[quote]
[h1]Works in existing saves[/h1]
Joining a game with a character from before the mod was added will open the character customisation window.

Stubble and chest hair will automatically be converted.
[/quote]

[quote]
[h1]Change Customisation In-Game[/h1] 
There is a sandbox option to allow players to open the customisation window and change their face or details in-game.

[b]The buttons to change your appearance and body hair are in the character info panel.[/b]

Admins are always able to change their appearance, but they can spawn an [b]Appearance Changing Spiffo[/b] item which gives this ability to players when held.

There is also a sandbox option to hide customisation options with specific categories from normal players. Admins can spawn an [b]Appearance Unlocking Bear[/b] item which will unhide these options when held.

Body hair growth and visible muscles can be enabled or disabled - but there is also an option where players can toggle them on their character from the customisation window.

There is also the option to set if missing eyes will affect the players vision cone. This is exclusive to B42

[/quote]

[quote]
[h1]Mod Support[/h1]
I've tried my best to make character customisation as moddable as possible - new faces and details can be easily inserted into the mod.

The body hair textures used in this mod will cut off at the underwear which will look broken when using a nude mod.

[b]I have included nude versions of the body hair textures that you can freely use.[/b] There are 256 and 512 resolution files.

You can add any clothing item as a face or detail option as long as they use an appropriate bodylocation that won't collide with other items.

You can also add fullbody textures but they will appear above muscles. 

All of the functionality for getting and setting a characters customisation is accessible which should hopefully make it easy to add support for NPC mods.

[h3]See the readme and Example.lua for an explanation of the mods features[/h3]

[list]

You can disable muscles in sandbox settings if the retexture you are using does not support it

Nude mods will need to replace the body hair textures to avoid it cutting off at the underwear line
	
    [*]Improved Hair Menu

[/list]
[/quote]

[quote]
[h1]Incompatibilities[/h1] 
[list]
    [*][b]Some clothing mods might cause transparency issues with customisation. This is caused by having a broken masks folder that is missing textures for bodyparts. To fix this you can copy the missing textures into the masks folder from media\textures\Body\Masks[/b]

    [*]Mods that access the players clothing without doing any extra checks on the items will cause weird side effects
	
Starving Zombies checks the blood of all clothing items, including customisation, so having a non-default face selected will make zombies twice as attracted to the player

[quote]

Studying the code from the Furry mod by Jaql and Wuffwick as well as Ra's Body Mod helped me make this mod, but I haven't used any of their code.

title: [B41/B42] Rain Cleans Blood
description:
Tired of zombies splattering their brains all over your pretty lawn? Well no more! Just wait for some rain or snow and watch it all fade away.

[h1]What does it do?[/h1]
This mod makes it so that when it's raining or snowing, blood will slowly fade away from floors and walls nearby.

[h1]Doesn't Rain Wash do this already?[/h1]
That mod cleans your clothes and recent car. This mod complements that.

[h1]Does it work in multiplayer?[/h1]
Yes, it does!

[h1]What about ash?[/h1]
Same as blood, ashes will also slowly be cleaned when it's raining.

[h1]Can I add this to my current game?[/h1]
Yes, you can add or remove this mod whenever you like. It contains no save-breaking features.

[h1]How does it work?[/h1]
Every game tick the mod will look at the current weather and if it's moderately raining or snowing, it will randomly select 8 tiles in the same chunk as you and clean them if they are bloodied.

[h1]Why not always?[/h1]
Because immersion is important to me. I also opted for a more gradual process to save on performance and to give the feature the feeling of "washing away".

description:
Added animations to opening doors/trunks/hoods to vanilla vehicles.

[h1]Build 42 compatability[/h1]
This mod should work with both build 41 and build 42.

If mod that were supported in build 41 get updated to build 42 - they should retain compatability. Especially ones adding more skins to vanilla vehicles (like Donny's Company Cars). Mods that introdiced more vehilce models (like Drive 90s) - might experience issues with interior and engine block textures. This also applies to Vanilla Vehicles Enhancer.

Standard Vehicles Upgrades compatability

[h1]Support mod creator[/h1]
If you want to see this mod updated and expanded further - please consider supporting me on [url=https://boosty.to/hilvon1984]Boosty[/url]
Being able to pay my bills withoug sacrificing a huge chunk of my life would mean more cool stuff I can make for this game.

[h1]Mod Compatibilities:[/h1]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3123709351]Small Town First Reponders[/url] - vehicles based on vanilla designs should be animated.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2719327441]Snake's modpack[/url] - pimp up my ride - vehicles linked to animations.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3279487562]Drive 90s[/url] - Added animations for vehicles.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2788428718]Vanilla Vehicle Enhancer[/url] - Added alternative models to all vehicles affected by VVE. If you spot animated parts shape not matching the outlines on the texture - please let me know so I can fix it.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3024365998]Standard Vehicle Upgrades[/url] - Compatability patch now covers [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3024365998]SVU2[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3304582091]SVU3[/url]. It requires neither as dependency and uses lua to figure out which one is active.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3162566044]More immersive vehicles[/url] - Compatible, and highly recommended.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2959512313]Sync vehicle animations[/url] - Compatible. Though based on some reports only final states are properly synchronised, whle transition animations remain local.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2904920097]Fancy Handwork[/url] - Should work fine with base mod. Adding armor to doors speeds up animations for some reason - optional submod slows down animations even more to compensate. Unfortunatelly it also make unarmored door REALLY slow.

[h2]FAQ:[/h2]
[h3]Q: Is the mod "old save safe"?[/h3]
A: It should be. It does not change game data. Only models used to present this data to the player. However with VanillaVehiclesEnhancer enabled sports car "trunk" was remodelled to only be rear window frame. And a dependency was added so trunk can only be removed if the rear window is removed. If you had rear window installed but trunk missing before you enable the mod, the rear window can become visually glitched. But that still should fix itself if you get all parts installed correclty. Other than that - feel free to add or remove it midgame or mid-server.

[h3]Q: Why didn't developers handle this themselves?[/h3]
A: They basically did. The interiors and "Engine block pictures" are taken from original vanilla vehicle models and textures. All I had to do was to separate one mesh with submeshes into separate meshes, add 2 keyframe animations and write a boatload of definition files to link it all together. My guess is the developers stumpled upon the problem of syncing animations across MP and decided to can the animations for now. Thankfully now we have a "[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2959512313]Sync vehicle animations[/url]" mod to adress it. And since developers have their hands full with Build42, I helped them take this last step.

[h3]Q: There is that vanilla-like vehicle mod that might need animations too. Can you add animations to it?[/h3]
A: I'd be glad to. But I am just one person and with vanilla cars I got really lucky that geometry was already set up. Processing more models that don't have doors already represented in geometry and don't have interior might take significantly longer. But feel free to start a discussion with links to mods you want me to look into.

[h3]Q: Is this mod compatable with Filibuster Rhyme's Used Cars?[/h3]
A: It causes no promlems when being used alongside FR cars, but does not add animations to them. If you want to have Filibuster Rhyme's cars animated - search workshop for [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3315561157]beta version of animated FR cars[/url].

[h3]Q: Is PZK: VLC supported[/h3]
A: Not in this mod. There are a lot of new models to be reworked. However I am making [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3331128480]another mod specifically for PZK.[/url]. It is currently unlisted, and might not be the most bug free (though if I know of some issues I tent to postpone in progress updates till I fix them). Also if you want to help me develop it faster - please consider supporting me on Boosty.

[h2]Want to see mods being made?[/h2]
Follow [url=www.twitch.tv/hilvon1984]my Twitch[/url]
I plan to stream 9am till 1pm GMT every saturday. Though time might be subject to change if the audience from a different timezone is gathered.

title: Inventory Tetris - Grid Based Inventory Overhaul [B42]
description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/agDCBaI.png[/img]

[h1]MAJOR NEW FEATURES IN B42[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Controller support[/b]
[*] Clothing pockets
[*] Sandbox option to remove vanilla capacity from containers
[*] Rebalanced container sizes
[*] Rebalanced item stacking
[*] Improved mod compatibility
[*] Many bug fixes
[*] Heavily optimized performance

[/list]

See the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/changelog/3397561666]Change Notes[/url] for more details.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/31mCw6B.gif[/img]

[h1]Inventory Tetris[/h1]
Inventory Tetris is a comprehensive inventory overhaul for Project Zomboid.
[list]
[*] The inventory is replaced with a grid based system.
[*] All items now have a size.
[*] [b]See inside all your equipped bags at once[/b]
[*] Bags now provide additional inventory space, not just weight reduction.
[*] Worn items do not take up inventory space.
[*] No more shoving 3 boxes of cereal and a carton of milk in your pants.
[/list]

[h1]CONTROLS[/h1]
[h2]Keyboard & Mouse[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b][i]Drag and Drop[/i][/b] - Almost everything can be dragged and dropped across the inventory
[*] [b][I]Split Stacks[/i][/b] - Drag and drop while holding [b]CTRL[/b]
[*] [b][i]Popup Window![/i][/b] - Double click on containers to open them in a popup window
[*] [b][i]Quick Gather[/i][/b] - Double click on stackable items to quickly gather them up
[*] [b][i]Rotate items[/i][/b] - Press [b]R[/b]*
[*] [b][i]Quick Move[/i][/b] - Hold [b]CTRL[/b] + Left Click
[*] [b][i]Quick Equip[/i][/b] - Hold [b]ALT[/b] + Left Click
[/list]
[b][i]Check out keybinds and mod options to customize these controls![/i][/b]

[h2]Controller[/h2]
[b][i]Written in Xbox[/i][/b]

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*] A - Menu
[*] B - Pickup
[*] X - Quick move
[*] Y - Close inventory/popup
[*] SELECT - Open equipment panel
[*] LB - Change/select inventory window
[*] RB - Change/select loot window
[/list]

[b]While holding item[/b]
[list]
[*] A - Rotate
[*] B - Drop
[*] Y - Cancel
[/list]

[b]While hovering over a container[/b]
[list]
[*] B+B - Open container popup
[/list]

[h1]TRAITS[/h1]
Inventory Tetris makes sure to give new uses to the vanilla traits related to the inventory!
[list]
[*] [b]Organized[/b] - Does nothing right now, will improve autosort when it is added.
[*] [b]Disorganized[/b] - When using quick move, items will not always stay stacked and will end up in a random spot in the grid. Cannot autosort (in the future when its added).

[*] [b]Dextrous[/b] - Faster container searching.
[*] [b]All Thumbs[/b] - Slower container searching.
[/list]

[h1]Search Mode![/h1]
[i]Use sandbox settings when creating your world to enabled searching!
When enabled, containers must be searched before they can be looted.[/i]

[h1]FAQ[/h1]
[h2]How do I open the keyring?[/h2]
Double click it. The items will be shown in a pop-up window.

[h2]Furniture is too big for my bag![/h2]
Use your hands. Equip the furniture as you would a weapon.
Your hands can only hold 1 item each, but the items they hold can be as big as you want.

[h2]How do I place a thing? It is too big for my main inventory.[/h2]
If you want to place a large item such as a tent or furniture, equip the item into your hand as if it was a weapon.
Once the item is equipped, it will appear as an option when trying to place/build objects.

[h2]My game lags / Low FPS[/h2]
Ensure that the following game options is CHECKED:
[code]Options -> Display -> UI -> UI Offscreen Rendering -> CHECK[/code]
You can now use the use the UI Rendering FPS dropdown to choose a target FPS to reduce the performance demand.

[h2]Can I add/remove this on existing saves?[/h2]
Yes.
Inventory Tetris can added/removed at any point without issue.
(Note: When adding the mod the player may drop items to the ground if they do not have enough space.)

[h2]How do items from other mods works?[/h2]
Inventory Tetris automatically examines items from other mods and determines what size they should be.

[h2]Make My Own Changes?[/h2]
[i]Inventory Tetris includes some very easy to use dev tools that can be used to quickly create compatibility/balance packs to provide more fine tuned support for popular mods or fit your personal tastes.[/i]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3044166761&searchtext=tetris]GUIDE HERE - By Lily[/url]

title: [B42] Day One (Bandits)
description:
[h1]Day One[/h1]
[b]Day One[/b] is a prelude that immerses you in the [b]first day of the zombie apocalypse[/b]. Picture yourself amidst the initial chaos as the dead begin to rise. People are scattered, desperately seeking safety or fighting for their lives. Violence intensifies until the government, in a final attempt to restore order, resorts to extreme measures to contain the virus.

After 24 hours — if you survive — the chaos will subside, but the world will be drastically different. This marks the beginning of your journey in a collapsed world.

This mod is brutal and fairly hard. If you are looking for a challenging and very immersive start, you may like it. 

It is compatible with both single-player and multiplayer modes. MULTIPLAYER is very demanding and it will work only in local network probably. 

Read about [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/3268487204/6015206955930260248/#c6015206955930599738]Compatibility[/url] before posting bug reports. If you have errors despite removing incompatible mods, post error messages.

Check the [url=https://discord.gg/P5BqtCMNqR]Bandits Discord[/url].

[h2]B41 vs B42[/h2]
This mod works for B41 and B42 however, B41 version lacks some of the features that B42 has. B41 also runs using the legacy Bandit engine so it lacks many features and fixes that new version provides. I do not develop B41 version nor do I support it (I will not be answering questions and requests). [b]If you want to use B41 version note that you must also subscribe to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3472321531]Bandits Legacy[/url] mod. [/b]

[h2]How to use this mod[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]You should always start a new game with this mod[/b]. Adding this mod to an existing save or server after the first day of the apocalypse has passed will not work. In multiplayer, it is advised that all players start simultaneously to experience the events together. 
[*]Although all events in this mod run from a predefined schedule, [b]every start experience will be different[/b] because starting parameters have huge impact on how the game progresses. If you want chaos as this mod promises,  you should start in the city with high population. It's best to create a sandbox game with population factor 1.5 - 2.5. You can also add more cars. 
[*] [b]Starting day and hour should be default[/b]. Day length should be set to 1 hour (2 hours is acceptable but will make things a lot less intense), other options not recommended. 
[*]You can tune intensity of some of the features of this mod in the sandbox settings. Mod must be enabled in the game itself to see sandbox option.
[/list]

Initially all spawned NPCs  are friendly unless attacked by the player. This includes various civilians and government forces. However, after some time you will encounter hostile groups such as inmate escapees, criminals or even psychiatric hospital patients. Your job is simply to survive but also to be prepared for facing the enemy which may find you[/b]. 

This mod utilizes the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3268487204]Bandits[/url] mod as an NPC engine to introduce non-zombie characters to the game. The compatibility of this mod is practically identical as the Bandits mod compatibility. If you run into errors, check Bandits mod guidebook compatibility section.

There is a lot of action, the [b]performance may be impacted[/b], but on a decent PC it should work. The performance will mainly depend on the starting zombie population size.

title: [B42] Knox Event Expanded NPC mod [alpha v0.2.27]
description:
[h1]Knox Event Expanded[/h1]
The goal of this NPC mod is to add npcs through engine modifications.

The inspiration for this comes from various Thursdoids Indie Stone have published during the last ~10 years, which I am basically trying to recreate as good as possible. My goal is to enhance the endgame experience by bringing npcs into the mix by allowing them to exist from the very beginning of the outbreak, and later develop into various factions.

The B41 version of this mod can be found [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3335447777]here[/url].

[h3]IMPORTANT[/h3]
This mod relies on modified class files that must be installed manually. Instructions for how to install can be found in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/3397396843/595136892797764113/]Installation guide[/url]
NOTE: Map mods will not work well with the npcs when they are in the metaverse as their movement is implemented right now. It relies on waypoints, which in turn requires manual work to map out the roads for the npcs to move in a good way. This will be addressed in the future.

Before asking questions, please see the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/3397396843/592885544240847911/]Frequently asked questions thread[/url].

[h2]Current features[/h2]
[olist]
    [*]Npcs are procedurally generated when starting the game the first time. This simulates their lives between 1953 and 1993. This includes bandits.
    	[*]Npcs remember what have happened before and after the Knox Event began, and will tell you about it if you ask them.
    	[*]Dynamic migration system where npcs will migrate into the zone to replace ones that have died.
    	[*]Meta events where npcs will call for help over radio on [b]90MHz[/b], if you are close enough (within 200 squares).
    	[*]Call out over radio that you are looking for survivors. Npcs within 200 squares will respond and their safehouses will be marked on your map. They will also give directions on [b]90MHz[/b].
    	[*]Even when you are not around them, npcs will continue to live their lives in the background.
    	[*]Military faction that guard the Louisville checkpoint, with guard rotations, and enforces curfew at night. They communicate via radio on [b]92MHz[/b].
    	[*]Inventory system for giving npc items e.g. food and equipment, and changing what they wear and which weapon they use.
    	[*]Npcs in your group can be sent out to scavenge or ordered to loot e.g. if they are out on a loot run together with you.
    	[*]Npcs will not take kindly to you trepassing in their home and will turn hostile if you don't leave.
    	[*]Npcs can be robbed by the player.
[/olist]

[h2]Roadmap[/h2]
[olist]
    [*]RW-style management of npc jobs.
	    [*]Survival behaviors - npcs will take care of their needs i.e. find food, water, shelter etc.
    [*]More advanced procedural generation of npcs.
    [*]Player faction integration (npcs can be a part of a player faction).
    [*]Dynamically formed npc factions.
	    [*]More combat improvements e.g. improved escape/hide behavior, usage of the [b]anger[/b] stat.
    [*]Expansion of the Military faction.
    [*]Dynamic waypoint system to better support custom maps.
    [*]More "static" npc factions (examples: police, EMT, fire fighters).
    [*]Driving npcs.
[/olist]
This is the current list of features and it is still subject to change. Just as with B42 in general, taking backups is recommended. Also, saves may break, since B42 is still in unstable.

For feature requests, please post them in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/3397396843/595136892797764283/]Feature/ideas thread[/url]

What's new in b42 ? Some stuff.

[*]Dextrous is now even more op somehow, giving bonuses to gun jamming 
[*]Desensitized no longuer negates panic, it greatly reduces panic instead
[*]And more things such as new traits, new free recipes, new effects...
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h1]NEW (b42) : Dynamic Free recipes[/h1]
Free recipes have been dynamically added to each trait and profession description, which means any future free recipe changes in vanilla will automatically show up on this mod, without needing to update the mod.
Modded traits will also have their free recipes added to their description, just like the foraging stats. And modded recipes will also dynamically show up if they are given for free to a trait or profession.

[hr][/hr]

[h1]NEW (b42) : Mod Options[/h1]
There are now 3 mod options :
[list]
[*]Show more description 
[*]Show Free Recipes
[*]Show Foraging Stats
[/list]
So you can now disable the things you don't want to see.

[hr][/hr]

[h1]Give your feedback[/h1]

I've tried to be as exhaustive as possible, but I'm sure I've made some mistakes or interpreted things wrongly here and there. Please tell me in the feedback & bug reports discussions , or just leave a comment.

[hr][/hr]

This mod is intended for players who are confused about what effects each trait and profession has on the character.

It adds description to the traits that need it to describe their effects on the character in detail, instead of leaving people guessing with vague sentences. This way, players can have an easier time imagining their own builds by themselves.

It also adds the description on mouse hover in the character's info screen, in game. This works with descriptions of traits from other mods too, like Banjo's item kits or Dynamic traits for example.

This is based on a combination of my own knowledge, the game's non-exposed Java files (that I learned how to decompile),  the game's exposed Lua files,  your feedback, and the wiki of PZ.

Most of what I added in the traits' descriptions are in parenthesis so you can distinguish what is vanilla description and what is not.

If you notice a typo, or know of an effect that is not listed, or spot something that is wrong or poorly worded, please leave a comment to point it out to me. I don't think I got every single effect that could be listed, and I may have made a mistake somewhere, so I'm relying on you guys for that.

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Compatibility[/h1]
Works with build 41, in multiplayer b41, and unstable b42.
It should also be compatible with any mod that adds traits or skills.

[hr][/hr]

[h1]Translations[/h1]
B41 translations are CLOSED.
B42 translations are open , but be advised that it risks becoming obsolete soon as B42 gets more matches, and I will most likely take a couple weeks to add the translation.

Anyone is welcome to volunteer to translate to their language.

[hr][/hr]
[h1] Foraging stats:[/h1]
The mod details the foraging stats bonuses for each trait and profession.
Stats are : Foraging radius bonus, Weather Effect reduction, and Darkness Effect reduction and also Specialisation bonuses for every foraging category.
All foraging stats are added dynamically, which means any balance changes will be automatically updated, and other traits that get foraging stats in their descriptions (if they have foraging stats).
Source file: media/lua/shared/Foraging/forageDefinitions.lua

[hr][/hr]
[h1] Character Info Screen Tooltip:[/h1]
The mod displays the detailed description of each trait in the character's info screen window on mouse hover. Works for professions too (except Unemployed since it doesn't have an image).
Works with traits of other mods too! Although their descriptions probably won't be as detailed.

title: Gyde's Trait Magazines
description:
[quote]
[h2]Thank you for 100k+![/h2]
Project crunch is over. This mod has been updated finally.
[/quote]

[h2]About[/h2]
Find and learn traits through trait magazines! All with unique and vanilla-friendly name and designs.

This mod is very customizable with sandbox settings, start a game in "Custom Sandbox" or use [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2670674997]Change Sandbox Options[/url] mod to change settings mid-game for a singleplayer game.

By default, if the player starts with a negative trait counterpart of a trait [i](like Disorganized vs Organized)[/i], reading the magazine will not give the positive trait but instead remove the negative trait. [i](*)[/i]
[i](*) This can be changed in sandbox settings to both remove and award the positive trait.[/i]

Other sandbox settings include the option to choose which magazines spawn, toggling of a trait by rereading a magazine [i](for those who want to toggle Speed Demon)[/i], and an option to change the spawn rate of all magazines.

[h2]Available Trait Magazines[/h2]
- Nutritionist
- Outdoorsman
- Handy
- Axe Man
- Burglar
[b]Traits with negatives [i](in brackets)[/i]:[/b]
- Speed Demon [i](Sunday Driver)[/i]
- Organized [i](Disorganized)[/i]
- Fast Learner [i](Slow Learner)[/i]
- Fast Reader [i](Slow Reader)[/i]
- Inconspicuous [i](Conspicuous)[/i]
- Graceful [i](Clumsy)[/i]
- Dexterous [i](All Thumbs)[/i]
- Keen Hearing [i](Deaf / Hard of Hearing)[/i] [i](*)[/i]
[i](*) Reading the Keen Hearing magazine with deaf will not do anything.[/i]

[h2]Finding Magazines[/h2]
All trait magazines can be found in common magazine locations like magazine racks and libraries. Some magazines have unique spawns where they have a higher spawn rate. For example, [i]"Fast Learner"[/i] can be found more commonly in schools and [i]"Burglar"[/i] more commonly in police/evidence lockers.

The spawn rates for magazines will differ in rarity depending on the value of the trait.

By default, the cheaper trait magazines are roughly as common as Skill Vol. 1 & 2 books. The more expensive trait magazines are roughly as rare as/rarer than [i]"How to Use A Generator"[/i] magazines.

Changing the sandbox spawn settings will multiply spawn rates accordingly: Very Low [i](0.1x)[/i], Low [i](0.5x)[/i], Default [i](1x)[/i], High [i](2x)[/i], Very High [i](3x)[/i]

[h2]Supported Languages[/h2]
Please report any translation errors or improvements in the discussion thread.
- English (EN)
- Traditional Chinese (CN)
- Spanish (ES) by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198873496414/]@Trapito222[/url]
- Portuguese Brazil (PTBR) by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/rafakes/]@Rafakes[/url]
- Russian (RU) by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/RevilSteam]@Revil[/url]
- Korean (KO) by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/kayoung]@MUKI[/url]
- Polish (PL) by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/monib]@Nacho Juarez[/url]
- Turkish (TR) by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/kazoolovesyou]@kazoo[/url]
- Japanese (JP) by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198095505091]@sync01[/url]
- Italian (IT) by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/Art_Tippet]@Art Tippet[/url]
- Indonesian (ID) by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/Shieru]@Shieru[/url]
- French (FR) by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198027815009]@Bobitec[/url]
- German (DE) by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/xBeathovenx]@Beathoven[/url]

[h2]Extra Notes[/h2]
I mainly made this mod because I wanted a way to learn Nutritionist, figured why not design and add magazines for other traits as well.

Also, this is my first time delving into Zomboid mod making so I'd highly appreciate suggestions or bug reports in the comments, thanks!

[h2]FAQ[/h2]
[b]Q: Does this work in multiplayer?[/b]
[i]A: Yes![/i]

[b]Q: Can I add this mod mid-save / ongoing world?[/b]
[i]A: Yes, but the magazines will only spawn in unexplored chunks. If you're adding this mod on a late save, I'd recommend resetting chunks outside of your base or in previously looted towns.[/i]

[b]Q: Does reading magazines also give XP/level for skills? [i](E.g. Handy's +1 Carpentry & +1 Maintenance)[/i][/b]
[i]A: No, reading magazines will only give the associated trait.[/i]

[b]Q: Can you add support for X mod's traits?[/b]
[i]A: Unfortunately there are too many trait mods to create magazine designs for, so I'm sticking with vanilla traits only. Though if you would like to expand or create an add-on for the mod, you have my full permission to look through the code and attempt it yourself![/i]

[b]Q: Is this compatible with Evolving Traits World or mods that add or remove traits dynamically?[/b]
[i]A: Functionally, this mod simply looks through the traits you have and if it matches the vanilla trait, it will add or remove it. If the mod changes the name for traits, this mod will not work. With dynamic trait mods, adding/removing traits may also be undone depending on how and when they check for conditions.[/i]

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
- Some languages are missing translation for consumable magazine option in sandbox. [i](WIP, waiting for translators)[/i]

title: [B42] Useful Barrels
description:
[h1] Barrels can actually be more than just a sprite! [/h1]
[b]B42 only![/b]
[h2] Features [/h2]
[list]
    [*]Use your Pipe Wrench to open the lid of the barrel!
    [*]Store any fluid inside
    [*]The amount of liquid inside the barrel affects the encumbrance
    [*]Rubber Hose to take Gas from barrel
    [*]Funnel for pouring Gas into the barrel
    [*]Funnel may speedup pouring action
    [*]Refueling generator from the barrel
    [*]Refueling vehicle from the barrel. and vice versa.
    [*]Randomized initial fluid and amount
    [*]Sandbox vars to control mod behaviour as you want
    [*]Chuckleberry Finn's Mod Update and Alert System integration for ingame ChangeLog
[/list]

[h2] Notes [/h2]
[list]
    [*]Uses new FluidContainer system of B42
    [*]Is safe to add in existing saves as well as removing, FuidContainer will remain
    [*]Barrels are now less fragile! But anyway Walkers will break it pretty quickly
    [*]Gasoline does not evaporate from the barrels
    [*]Modded vehicles and trailers are supported if the vehicle has a part with the "gastank" category and the part containerType contains the word "Gasoline" (this information is mostly for modders)
    [*]Please! Any full 800L barrels in your characters pocket or car trunk is your responsibility, there is no proper way to haul them. For now at least.
[/list]

[h2] How to [/h2]
[h3] Base usage [/h3]
[list]
    [*]Find a Pipe Wrench and any metal barrel in the game (there are only four types available)
    [*]Move it to the garage at your base
    [*]Right click on it and select "Uncap ..." option
    [*]Find a Rubber Hose and a Funnel, then place them on the barrel to enable fluid transfer
[/list]
[h3] Refuel generator [/h3]
[list]
    [*]The generator must be near the barrel with at least 1 liter of fuel
    [*]The generator must be turned off and have free space for fuel
    [*]Find a Rubber Hose if you haven't found it yet, then place it on the barrel (or keep it in your inventory)
    [*]Right click on the generator and select "Refuel From Barrel"
[/list]
[h3] Refuel vehicle [/h3]
[list]
    [*]The vehicle must be near the player
    [*]The vehicle's engine must be turned off
    [*]The gas tank must have free space
    [*]The barrel with gas must be near the vehicle
    [*]Find a Rubber Hose if you haven't found it yet, then place it on the barrel (or keep it in your inventory)
[/list]
[h2] About two versions [/h2]
The mod now comes with two versions: stable and beta.
Stable is polished and works well. Receives an update from beta as soon as it works smoothly.
Beta gets new features early and may be buggy but don't worry, i'm here to fix them asap.

[h2] WIP [/h2]
[list]
    [*]Rework plumbing to make it work again properly
    [*]Add sprite and craftrecipe for rain collector
[/list]

[h2] Future plans [/h2]
[list]
    [*]Add posibility to move barrel with fluid
    [*]Connect the barrel to the generator with a hose and refuel it over time
[/list]

[h2]Mods compatibility[/h2]
[list]
    [*] Modded vehicles (and fluid trailers) should be compatible if: vehicle has part and part category contains "gastank", part contentType contains word "Gasoline".
    [*] Mods that adds context options for FuidContainer may interfere UB. In that case try to re-order mods in Mod load order and move UB to bottom as possible.
[/list]

[h2] Known bugs [/h2]
[list]
    [*]In case of game crash FuidContainer may not save it's contents
[/list]

[h2] FAQ [/h2]
[list]
    [*]Q: Why 800L? In the real world, the barrel has N litres!
    [*]A: 800L was chosen because previously devs used that amount for barrels near Louisville
    [*]Q: b41 when?
    [*]A: I dont have any plans to port it on b41. And there is already a mod for b41, it's called "Fiel API"

title: [B42/B41]Project Seasons
description:
[h1]Project Seasons:[/h1]


If you're tired of that repetitive vanilla erosion, this mod will change that by changing the textures to make the erosion more varied and denser and matching the seasons, It will also add a little more of that apocalyptic atmosphere that everyone loves.



[h3]Example:[/h3]

- dry leaves and pink leaves scattered across the roads at their respective times of year, and branches scattered across the streets.

- more varied vegetation matching the respective time of year (no more of that repetitive grass that grows on the roads).

- It also improves the final stage of erosion (after 6 or 12 months), changing the textures to leaving vegetation more denser

- cars rust with time

- extra vines may appear, house interiors will appear dirtier and more abandoned, and roofs will have a more worn appearance, all of which will occur over a period of 30, 50, 90 days. [h3](NOTE: At the moment this only happens in regions the player has never visited.)[/h3]

- Bonus two new breeds of raccoons (Brown and Spiffos)



I still plan to add more things and small details to make the world much more alive and beautiful.

[h1]Can I clean erosion from inside houses?[/h1]

yes, all you will need is a broom or a twig broom, right click on the place you want to clean and click "cleanerosion" (this does not work for cracks)

The version of this mod in b41 is a bit more limited and doesn't have some things, like the rust system and the new extra erosion progression, but I'm working on implementing all of that soon.

In B41 you'll still have the new erosion textures that change with the seasons and make the erosion denser.

[h1]Bandits[/h1]

[b]IMPORTANT: The mod has been updated to new major version for B42 and B41. It is best to start a new save. You can also re-enable the mod for a current save, but this may lead to errors. Bandits2 introduces many changes and it's best to stop for a moment to read about the changes.[/b]

Also try [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3469292499]Bandit Creator[/url] mod which now controls spawn settings and many other aspects of bandits.

[i]During the zombie apocalypse, It's not the zombies you should be afraid of; it's the people...[/i]

This mod introduces hostile (NPC) bandits into the game. Please be aware that the enemies in this mod are extremely dangerous, and provide an extent of challenges. Treat them as actual players when it comes to combat. You will need to relearn how to survive.

[b]WORKS IN MULTIPLAYER and WITH EXISTING SAVES and ALL MAPS![/b]

Check [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/changelog/3268487204]What's new[/url].

[b]I happily respond to questions unless it is clear you haven't read the description first. Please mention game version when commenting or posting bug reports.[/b]

Check the [url=https://discord.gg/P5BqtCMNqR]Bandits Discord[/url].

If you like my work, be sure to give it a [b]LIKE[/b] or:
[url=/ko-fi.com/M4M7SGR4P][img]https://storage.ko-fi.com/cdn/kofi2.png?v=3[/img][/url]

[h2]Bandit Spawning[/h2]
Initially, a small groups of armed individuals with melee weapons appear in the world. Over time, much larger groups armed with handguns and rifles will arrive to take your head. In multiplayer on the other hand, this happens independently for each player. Newer players will have more so simple bandits attacking them, whereas long term players will have stronger bandits attacking them.

[h2]Bandit Customization[/h2]
Some general customization is done via sandbox settings just like for any other mods.

Customization of bandit looks, weapons and spawn settings is now controlled by  [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3469292499]Bandit Creator[/url] which is a separate mod you need to subscribe to in order to make changes.

[h2]What you need to know about v2 version[/h2]
[list]
[*] Besides killing you, bandits can steal items from you base, sabotage your generators, vehicles or crops. 
[*] Bandits can destroy things: obstacles and furniture blocking their way, destroy doors and windows, destroy or remove barricades, naturally they can also simply open doors or gates. 
[*] They can have different extra traits which determine their extra skills
[*] They carry different loot depending to their profession and skills
[*] They will resupply with weapons or ammo from dead corpses and containers nearby. 
[*] Some of them rarely may bite you as a recently infected desperate individuals. 
[*] They don't know where you are until they see you or until they hear you. 
[*] They can shoot all weapons, including shotguns, revolvers or rifles with scopes, weapon range depends on weapon now. 
[/list]

[h2]Troubleshooting[/h2]
[b]There are no bandits[/b]
Do not turn off zombies in your world completely. Otherwise Bandits will not spawn. Turning off zombie respawn is ok.
Their spawning has a large random factor. But if they don't spawn for 5-7 consecutive days then something may be wrong. 

[b]I have too many icon on the screen[/b]
Notification icons show up only if they are turned on in sandbox settings.  The icon points to the spawn location, not the actual position of any bandit. The icon will vanish automatically. To make it go away, double click it.

title: [B42]Clean HotBar v1.7
description:
[h2]V1.7 Update[/h2]  
+ Added a feature to show/hide empty slots.  
+ Improved the display of the settings button — it now only appears when the mouse hovers over the hotbar.  

[h2]V1.6 Update[/h2]
+ Added separate settings for hotbar and hand-equipped items  
+ Added new animation for ammo  
+ Add progress bar for equipping/unequipping items,and smooth border color transitions.
+ Optimized texture rendering method

[h2]V1.5 Update[/h2]
+ Optimized all number displays  
+ Improved the rendering of some textures  
+ Added incompatible mods and load order info in modinfo  
+ Refactored the code structure  

[hr]
When playing Project Zomboid, this Hotbar UI has always annoyed me. Unlike most games' UI designs, it fails to intuitively display weapon status and blocks part of the screen visibility. That's why I've been redesigning this UI for a long time. After studying equipment UIs from various games, I've found a more optimal solution.

[h2]B42-Compatible Status Display[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/vSq7e8H.png[/img]
This mod visually integrates all new weapon/item statuses added in B42:
[list]
[*][b]Weapon Head Condition:[/b] Displays a status bar above the slot if weapon has head condition data
[*][b]Weapon Sharpness:[/b] Similar to head condition but with two values:
[list]
[*]White: Actual sharpness
[*]Brown: Maximum sharpness (see [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/3461263912/600775381612528270]here[/url])
[*][b]Toggleable Items:[/b] Clear ON/OFF indicators for items like flashlights
[*][b]Ammo Counter:[/b] Displays ammunition count above firearm slots
[/list]

[h2]Hand-Equipped Display Improvements[/h2]  
[img]https://i.imgur.com/qdn3lSz.png[/img]  
Now it's not just the hotbar,hand-equipped can also display more detailed information.  
Additionally, the original game’s textures have been optimized with added transparency.

[h2]B42 Liquid System Integration[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Hx8z1gT.png[/img]
The new B42 liquid system is visualized with color-coded bars. While I used AI-generated color values (which may have inaccuracies), you can easily identify liquid types. Please provide feedback for any inconsistencies.

[h2]Animation Effects[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/KMJ1EZb.gif[/img]
Designed to minimize distraction while providing durability alerts:
[list]
[*][b]Durability Shake:[/b] Items shake during durability loss (e.g. flashlight battery drain)
[*][b]Flashing Effect:[/b] Durability values flash when decreasing
[*][b]Liquid Drain:[/b] Smooth animation mimicking drinking actions
[*]A warning appears above the character's head when the durability of the equipped weapon decreases (can be disabled in the settings panel).
[/list]

[h2]Customizable Settings[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/tr3AbW6.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Disable all status displays for hardcore players
[*]Adjust status bar heights to your preference
[*]Enable [b]tooltips[/b] (default: off) to show item details on hover
[*]Scale the size of hotbar
[*]Toggle weapon durability warning animation above character.
[/list]

[h2]Compatibility[/h2]
[list]
[*]Compatible with "Reorder the Hotbar" — I’ve also designed a better integration method for it: the button that originally appeared on the hotbar is now moved to the settings panel (for best results, place Clean Hotbar at the bottom of the load order, loading other mods first).
[*]There may be conflicts with any mods that display status indicators on the hotbar.
[*]If you encounter any errors or the mod doesn't work as expected, try placing Clean Hotbar at the bottom of the mod load order so other mods load first.[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/pEPGwZV.png[/img]

[h2]Handheld Equipment Slot[/h2]
Currently only basic status displays implemented. Open to creative suggestions!

[hr]
If you enjoy my mod and your circumstances allow, it would be amazing if you could buy me a cup of coffee, but first and foremost, enjoy your game!

title: RV Interior
description:
[h1] READ THE INSTRUCTIONS BEFORE ENABLING THE MOD[/h1]

Simulate interiors of some vehicles. Support over a 100 vehicles.

Each vehicle has 25 fully-customizable independent spaces.

The power is tied to the car battery. Some trailers have no battery of their own, and need to be attached to another vehicle to have power.

Some vehicles are entered from the back (trunk area) via the radial menu or hotkey. The trunk can be locked to avoid entry.

An interior with a sink has water collector on the roof available for plumbing.

[h1]Instructions[/h1]

[hr][/hr]

[b][list]
[*] /!\ FOLLOW [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2547762158]THIS GUIDE[/url] TO ADD THE MOD TO AN EXISTING SAVE. FOR MP FOLLOW [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2822286426/5260782129623793867/]PHONEY'S GUIDE[/url] IN THE DISCUSSION.

[*]Non-standard maps (such as Challenge maps) are not supported.

[*]In Multiplayer, the map file "vehicle_interior" needs to be put in top priority. Map=vehicle_interior;OtherMaps;Muldraugh, KY;

[/list][/b]

To exit an interior, right click on the ground and select the "Exit" context menu option.

With the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2169435993]Mod Options[/url] mod installed, a hotkey can be defined to enter and exit the interior (Options -> Keybindings -> Vehicle)

The safe zombie distance to enter can be configured (or disabled) in the Sandbox options.  Players in SP who want to change these mid-game can use the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2670674997]Change Sandbox Options[/url] mod.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/vZ2Lghv/gif-mod.gif[/img]

[h1]Updated for Build 42[/h1]
The add-on has been [b][u]updated for Build 42[/u][/b] while a separate version for [b][u]Build 41 remains untouched and fully compatible[/u][/b], thanks to a new files structure system where each version of the mod is only visible by its respective game build, ensuring seamless functionality for players on both versions.

[b][u]Only for B42[/u][/b], It now includes a new muscle strain indicator for each body part. The indicator evolves by becoming less transparent and changes color from orange to red as muscle strain worsens.

If auto-hide is enabled, the silhouette is revealed with a brief blinking effect when a strain threshold is reached.

This feature can be toggled off if not needed.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/BnjPXPr.gif[/img]

It give a permanent overview of your character's wounds on a minimalistic display. The body silhouette disappear when there are nothing to treat and appear when there is a wound.

When a body part is flashing red, there is a wound that needs to be treated.
When it's white, the wound is either bandaged or splinted.
When it's orange, the bandage is dirty and needs to be replaced.

If the wound is bandaged but it's still flashing that means you didn't fully treated the wound (glass still lodged, deep wound needs to be stitched, etc...)

[h1]How to use it?[/h1]
Right clicking on the component will bring a contextual menu with all wounds and the settings of the addon.

Left clicking just brings up the classic health panel of the base game.

You also can drag it around and place it where you desire.

title: [VFE] VANILLA FIREARMS EXPANSION (B41)
description:
[h1]This upload will no longer be updated (I literally can't) but a B42 branch will happen when it's ready. I will keep this mod up for both B41 users and as a memorial. - Vilespring[/h1]

[h2]This mod replaces the models, textures and names of nearly all vanilla firearms, attachments, ammunition and magazines. It also adds several new lore-friendly weapons and items.[/h2]

[h1]⚠️ READ THE FAQ ⚠️[/h1]

As of this version, 23 new firearms (and their magazines), 6 attachments, and two new calibers of ammunition.

[h2]New Weapons[/h2]
SPAS-12 Shotgun - Rare semi-automatic shotgun with a folding stock and 7+1 magazine tube.

M590 Shotgun - Uncommon pump-action shotgun with a 7+1 magazine tube.

R1187 Shotgun - Uncommon semi-automatic shotgun with a 4+1 or 7+1 magazine tube.

MP5 Submachinegun - Rare select fire submachinegun using 30 round detachable magazines. Has a variant with folding stock and a built in flashlight.

MP5SD Submachinegun - Very rare suppressed select fire submachinegun using 30 round detachable magazines.

M10 Submachinegun - Very rare select fire machinegun using 32 round detachable magazines

Uzi Submachinegun - Very rare select fire machinegun using 32 round detachable magazines

Mini-14 Rifle - Uncommon semi-automatic rifle with 20 round detachable magazines. Has a folding stock variant.

W1866 Carbine - Common lever-action rifle with internal magazine of 8+1 rounds of .38 Special.

R92-44 Carbine - Common lever-action rifle with internal magazine of 8+1 rounds of .44 Magnum.

M2400 Combination Gun - Common break action rifle/shotgun. Chambered in .308 and Shotgun Shells.

AK-47 Assault Rifle - Very rare select fire assault rifle with 30 round detachable magazines. Has a folding stock variant.

MAK-90 Rifle - Uncommon semi-automatic rifle with 30 round detachable magazines. Basically a more common version of the AK-47.

FAL Battle Rifle - Very rare select fire rifle with 20 round detachable magazines.

CAR15 Assault Rifle - Very rare select fire assault rifle with 30 round detachable magazines.

TEC-9 Pistol - Uncommon semi-automatic pistol using 20 round detachable magazines.

G17 Pistol - Uncommon semi-automatic pistol using 17 round detachable magazines.

P229 Pistol - Uncommon semi-automatic pistol using 13 round detachable magazines.

CZ 75 Pistol - Uncommon semi-automatic pistol using 16 round detachable magazines.

Mk2 Pistol - Common semi-automatic pistol using 10 round detachable magazines. Has a rare integrally suppressed variant.

SKS Rifle - Uncommon semi-automatic rifle with 9+1 internal magazine. Has a variant with a built in bayonet.

R1022 Rifle - Common semi-automatic rifle using 10 round detachable magazines.

MC-45 Carbine - Common semi-automatic rifle using 7 round detachable magazines.

M24 Sniper Rifle - Very rare bolt-action rifle using a 5+1 internal magazine.

M60 Machinegun - Extremely rare automatic belt fed machinegun using 100 round belts. Requires ammunition with links and will drop the links while shooting.

M16 Masterkey Assault Rifle - Extremely rare select fire assault rifle with 30 round detachable magazines. Features an underbarrel shortened M590 shotgun with an internal tube magazine of 3 + 1.

M9 Bayonet - Uncommon knife. Can be mounted onto an M16 or M590 for use as a bayonet.

Entrenching Tool - Uncommon tool. Can be folded and used as either long blunt or an axe.


[h2]New Ammunition[/h2]
7.62 Ammunition - Used in AK47 and SKS Rifles.

.22 Ammunition - Used in R1022 rifle and Mk2 pistols.

Linked .308 Ammunition - .308 with the M13 Ammunition Link. Used in the M60 Machinegun.

[h2]New Attachments[/h2]
Bipod - Stabilizing bipod that can be attached to SKS, M14, R700, R788, and M24.

Shell Holder - Side mounted shotgun shell carrier to speed up shotgun reloads.

Shell Straps - Statistically the same as Shell Holder, but mounts on some weapons the Shell Holder cannot.

Lightened Stock - Statistically the same as the Fiberglass Stock but without the cosmetic changes.

Coupled magazines - Craftable taped assault rifle magazines to speed up reloads. (5.56 and 7.62)

Brass Catcher -  Cratable attachment for the M60 Machinegun that keeps links from dropping onto the ground.

This mod also rebalances weapon attachments in a manner that makes more sense compared to the vanilla game. (For example, you cannot mount a red dot sight on most handguns, excluding the DE Pistol, and the Magnum Revolver.)


[h2]Reworks to Jamming[/h2]
In vanilla when a weapon jams it consumes a round when it is unjammed. With VFE the round is returned if the gun is completely unloaded before clearing.

Jamming probability curve has been completely rewritten. In vanilla a 90% M16 only has a 50% chance of getting through a magazine without jamming. Now guns only begin to jam at 75% or 70%. They also start to jam more than vanilla guns do at 25% or 20%. Basically high condition guns jam less (or not at all) and low condition guns jam more often.

Manually cycled guns can jam now. Pump shotguns and bolt action rifles do their jam calculations when a round is chambered.

[h2]Zombies[/h2]
Many more zombies in the world can spawn with firearms on them. Survivor zombies have also been given a bit touch up.

[h2]Sandbox Options[/h2]
Quite a few aspects of the mod is configurable via sandbox settings. This is mostly toggles as to where VFE puts its guns, but also contains a multiplier for weapons in normal houses. An option exists to disable spawning of the M60 Machinegun, if such is desired.

This version of the mod is not final, we will continuously update adding new things and changing old ones.

[h2]FAQ[/h2]
Q: Is this mod compatible with Brita's/Arsenal26?
A: No. They are incompatible at the lua level. VFE is also designed around its own balance design, so using both at the same time doesn't make sense.

Q: I took an attachment off a weapon and it won't go back on.
A: You have a soft mod incompatibility. Another mod is overwriting attachments.

Q: A weapon doesn't accept an attachment that makes sense
A: Usually same story as previous question, but there is a chance it was missed. If its still true with just VFE in the modlist, report it. Also make sure you have a screwdriver in your inventory.

Q: Can this mod be installed mid save?
A: Yes and no. The new guns will spawn in unexplored locations, but guns already spawned will still retain their old stats, like damage and range. If you do decide to add it to an existing save you will have to delete and respawn all the guns you already have. The same is true with uninstalling. (when it comes to weapon stats)

Q: Does this mod have suppressors?
A: No. They're not off the table but they are also not a priority.

Q: Why are some guns invisible?
A: Maxwell's suppressor mod causes this when that mod is out of date. That is a problem with that mod, not VFE itself.

Q: Why are some guns tiger striped/rusted/wrong textures?
A: Issue with the texture optimization mod. Basically VFE changes textures for its models, but the texture optimization mod reverts them to vanilla.

[h2]Final Notes[/h2]

If you find any bugs, dislike something, or just have ideas you'd like to see incorporated into this mod, please let us know in the comments!

Special thanks to Alec for letting us use his magazine models from his mod, Ammo & Magazine icon MOD.
Special thanks to Great Hero J for creating various pixel art sprites that VFE uses as item/interface icons.

title: Fancy Handwork
description:
[h1]Supports B41. Works in Multiplayer[/h1]
[h3]A new save is not required[/h3]
[h1]A VERSION FOR B42 WILL BE AVAILABLE SOON.[/h1]
[h3]There is currently a bug in B42 where Animation Sets are not recognized from the new B42 folder structure, and thus have to be duplicated which doubles size of a B42 mod. This is an issue unique to Animations. Once this is fixed by the developers (it's been reported), the B42 version will be made available.[/h3]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hlfstr/pz-mods/devel/like_fav.gif[/img]

A Suite of Animations to make your player more alive!

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Attaching or Detaching an item to your Hotbar now has a chance to be done with the left arm
[*] Equipping and Unequipping your secondary item is now done with the left arm
[*] "Hand Swap" action to quickly swap the primary and secondary held items
[*] Modifier key to quickly equip items in secondary hand using from your Hotbar
[*] Animation Mask for the Left and Right Arms to correct the Positions and Rotation of the held item
[*] Includes 2 new poses when aiming a handgun and holding a secondary tool, based on your "Aim" level!  Configurable in the Sandbox Options.
[*] World Interaction animations!
[*] [b]NEW:[/b] World Interaction animations from the rear!
[*] Cooking Animations!
[*] Appropriate Vanilla Animations have now been placed on [b]over 50![/b] TimedActions that previously did not have one.
[*] [b]NEW:[/b] Wrench Repair Animation!
[/list]

[h2]Updates[/h2]
Important information is updated on this page, but full information and release notes are available in the Discussions.  Please see the latest: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2904920097/3762228679801751286/]Fancy Handwork - "It's Over 9,000!" Update[/url]

[h2]IMPORTANT[/h2]
If you receive an error about missing actions, or world interactions are simply not playing, you may need to restart Project Zomboid.  I have noticed that enabling this mod for the first time on an already-existing save and starting the game will result in the new animations not being loaded until the game is restarted. This is a [b]BASE GAME[/b] issue, but should only happen the first time.

If you receive an error following any update, please see: [url=https://theindiestone.com/forums/index.php?/topic/42925-how-to-fix-updated-mods-in-build-41-multiplayer/]How to fix updated mods in Build 41 Multiplayer[/url]
This mod adds many additional animation and action files, which may change between releases.  I try to minimize this, but sometimes it is necessary.  Unfortunately, Steam sometimes doesn't like to update these correctly resulting in errors.

[h2]Usage[/h2]
When Attaching or Detaching an item on your Hotbar, you have a chance for the action to automatically be done with your left hand.

A modifier key is added as well, which by default is bound to "Left Control".
[b]Note:[/b] By default, "Left Control" is the "Aim" key.  I personally do not use the keyboard to aim (its right-click on the mouse anyways) so I disable this keybind.  You are free to rebind the key in options.

When you press the Modifier Key and a Hotbar slot, the item slotted there will go into your Secondary Hand.  Example: (Left Control + 2) equips a Hammer to your left hand.

Pressing the Modifier and "E" will swap the items in your hands. (Configurable)

Interacting with the world normally, such as opening and closing doors and curtains, flicking light switches, and more, all now have an Animation!

Almost ALL TimedActions now have an Animation!  No longer will your character just stand there, waiting for a progress bar to fill up!

[h3]Notes about World Interactions[/h3]
If you are standing still you will turn and face the object you are interacting with if you are not already doing so. There is a Sandbox setting to control how long of a delay before you character is standing still, or the forced turn can be disabled or required.

When performing a World Interaction and moving your character will slow down slightly, and stop altogether in the case of opening a Garage Door, for a very brief moment.  I have no plans on this being a configurable option, and this is done intentionally.  It is a fantastic inclusion for immersion in my opinion, and in tight situations makes planning your movement all the more important.  After time, you will hardly notice it.
[b]NEW 01/19/2023[/b] - The speed reduction has been reduced from 50% to 25%.  This should help prevent the player from being trapped, while still being a nice addition to immersion.

[h2]Multiplayer[/h2]
Animations should sync across multiplayer with little to no issues!

[h2]Controllers[/h2]
There is currently no support for controllers, unless an action is done via the Context Menu. I will be working on Controller Support in a future Update.

[h2]Compatibility[/h2]
Mouse Click World Interactions are not triggered from: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2795987309]Left Click Redux - Click To Act[/url]
Compatible with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2915572347]The Only Cure but better[/url]. Thanks Pao!
Should be compatible with everything else.

title: Fuel Side Indicator
description:
[h1]EXCITING NEWS![/h1]
The latest blog post by The Indie Stone (https://projectzomboid.com/blog/news/2023/11/one-door-openz/) seems to hint that they will add a fuel-side indicator to the vanilla game on Build 42. 
I'm so happy that the developers noticed this small UI/UX tweak enough to warrant it to be in the base game. It has always been my intention to make this mod in the hopes of getting it implemented in vanilla.
Cheers to all who have supported this mod and I'm sure it will still come handy until B42 comes out.

Also,
This mod still works even though it's been over a year since I updated it. Works for Build 41.78+

[hr][/hr]

[h1] Build 41.68 Patch [/h1]
- Fixed error with Agrotsar Tractor*
- Fixed compatibility with two-wheeled vehicles**

**For some bikes, the mod makers made it so that you could refuel on both sides, in this case I have disabled the indicator.
*You may also find that the indicator does not appear in certain vehicles, this is because the mod makers have done some weird stuff on their vehicles that hinders this mod to get info on the gas tank location. One example of this is the Agrotsar Tractor that does not have a gas tank area which this mod relies on. 

[b]This mod should be loaded LAST. Specifically, after enabling other vehicle mods.[/b]
For server owners, place FSI at the end of the list of mods or after other vehicle mods. 

[hr][/hr]

[h1] Description [/h1]

Find it annoying to turn your vehicle around in a gas station and attracting MORE zombies? Do you wish there was a way to know which side your car's gas tank is at? 

[i]Fuel Side Indicator[/i] is a simple addition to your vehicle's dashboard that lets you know which side you have to park your car when refuelling!


[hr][/hr]
[h1] Author's Notes [/h1]

This is my first UI mod! Please be patient with any bugs you may encounter and report them in the comments below.

- No need for a new save, just enable it and you're ready
- To disable, just disable the mod itself

Big thanks to the PZ discord modding community! Special shout out to Shurutsue as well!

COMPATIBILITY: Build 41.78+
*Compatible with ALL vehicle mods! (as long as the vehicle has wheels)
*If you have a mod that tweaks the vehicle dashboard, this mod [i]may[/i] conflict with it but not likely if it's a minor tweak.

MULTIPLAYER COMPATIBILITY: 
* This should work since this is a client-side mod. Let me know down in the comments if you have trouble with the mod on your server.



REPACKING is ALLOWED. 
Just credit me and don't whine at me when something breaks when you repack.
